Chapter 6642: One Hand

Chapter 6642: One Hand

“Combine!” Their group fused their powers and wills in another attempt to stop the process.

Due to their number, the attack was rather potent. However, they faced a world where its inhabitants wanted to tie their fates together with Li Xingchen.

Normally, living beings were feeble and could be crushed like ants. Now, their wills under this process turned into an unstoppable flood.

“Boom!” The group was blasted away and vomited blood.

The combined wills noticed the threat and came for them, crushing stars along the way. The group joined together again for another oceanic wave.

“Bam!” They spat out more blood and turned pale, becoming more injured.

“Keep it up! We can’t let Li Xingchen take over!” Grand Preceptor shouted.

“Push!” Visceraless and the others mustered all of their strength.

At the same time, some overlords in Three Immortals almost had enough of this.

“You are pushing it.” An overlord with a profound gaze said.

Back at the battlefield, the combined will of World Seal had the clear upper hand.

“We’re losing!” Dugu Yuan shouted.

Despair surfaced as they watched their barriers crumble, one by one.

“This is it!” Eventually, the barriers shattered, leaving them exposed.

They closed their eyes, awaiting the crushing pressure.

“Bam!” Suddenly, everything stopped. They opened their eyes and saw an ordinary man lifting the duplicated world without any issue.

He was none other than Li Qiye, looking like a transcendent immortal floating in space. His raw strength alone lifted their world. No, he was beyond this. Overlords and immortals needed to prostrate before him.

“Sir!” Visceraless and the others rejoiced since they were saved.

“This dao is slanted, shackling the world isn’t blessing it.” Li Qiye frowned.

“Boom!” He clenched and crushed the duplicated world, causing particles to rain down on the real world.

Upon contact, these particles removed the glow from all inhabitants. They lost their blessing but were no longer tied to an overlord. The whole thing felt like a dream.

“A sign of a weak dao heart, only focusing on the now.” Li Qiye said before opening World Seal.

He easily forced the countless phenomena back into the heavenly dao. He then tossed the dao back into World City, creating a chasm.

World Seal flew into the chasm and its laws permeated throughout the city. It became blessed and reinforced. All beings were subjected to a cultivation limitation, immortals and overlords included.
